units.reusable_pattern: Accurately forecasted the first, but failed at. Keep 230th 280th.
information_order: accurately forecasted, but failed at
prohibited_generalizations: Do not report the forecast without the failed stretch.

units.source_excerpt: During this phase, Novak Djokovic unexpectedly gained a significant advantage. This is probably due to the effect of factors that our model does not account for
units.function: name who gained and blame the factors left out
units.reusable_pattern: Unexpectedly gained. This is probably due to factors our model does not account for.
information_order: unexpectedly, this is probably due to factors our model does not account for
prohibited_generalizations: Do not invent the missing factor.

units.source_excerpt: These can only be modeled through their historical performances and can't be inferred through our current approach (i.e. only consider players' rankings)
units.function: say what the approach can and cannot use
units.reusable_pattern: Can only be modeled through. Can't be inferred through our current approach, i.e.
information_order: can only be modeled through, can't be inferred, i.e.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not claim rankings carry playing style.

units.source_excerpt: Compared with Figure 12, one notable distinction is the impact of aces
units.function: compare the new figure with a numbered earlier one
units.reusable_pattern: Compared with Figure N, one notable distinction is.
information_order: compared with, one notable distinction is
prohibited_generalizations: Do not describe the new figure alone.

units.source_excerpt: the occurrence of double faults now clearly has a detrimental effect, as it is no longer the result of aggressive attempts to achieve an ace
units.function: reverse an earlier sign and give the reason
units.reusable_pattern: Now clearly has a detrimental effect, as it is no longer.
information_order: now clearly, as it is no longer
prohibited_generalizations: Do not keep the men's sign for the women's data.

units.source_excerpt: To demonstrate the adaptability of our model framework, we further generalize it into a more abstract and comprehensive form
units.function: give the reason for the abstraction before the figure
units.reusable_pattern: To demonstrate the adaptability, we further generalize.
information_order: to demonstrate the adaptability, we further generalize
prohibited_generalizations: Do not draw the general figure without saying what it is for.

units.source_excerpt: This framework can be instantiated into models that are capable of dealing all kinds of sports games such as table tennis, basketball, soccer
units.function: keep the missing preposition and name the sports
units.reusable_pattern: Capable of dealing all kinds of. Keep the slip. Name three sports.
information_order: dealing all kinds of
prohibited_generalizations: Do not repair dealing all kinds.

units.source_excerpt: Captures both short-term and long-term momentum effects through the two-layer structure
units.function: tie a strength to the structure that produces it
units.reusable_pattern: Captures both through the structure.
information_order: captures both, through the two-layer structure
prohibited_generalizations: Do not list a strength with no mechanism.

units.source_excerpt: Uses advanced machine learning techniques like expectation maximization to handle the latent variables and make the model trainable on real match data
units.function: name the technique and the thing it makes possible
units.reusable_pattern: Uses, to handle, and make the model trainable.
information_order: to handle, and make the model trainable
prohibited_generalizations: Do not praise the technique without its job.

units.source_excerpt: Weaknessess: Difficult to fully validate accuracy of latent variable representations without access to actual measurements of players' psychological states
units.function: keep the doubled s and name the missing measurement
units.reusable_pattern: Keep Weaknessess. Difficult to validate without access to.
information_order: weaknessess, difficult to fully validate, without access to
prohibited_generalizations: Do not repair Weaknessess.

units.source_excerpt: Does not account for opponent adaptive strategies and their influence on momentum. Assumes independent player behaviors
units.function: state the omission and the assumption it hides
units.reusable_pattern: Does not account for. Assumes.
information_order: does not account for, assumes
prohibited_generalizations: Do not call the players coupled.

units.source_excerpt: To evaluate the robustness of our proposed model, we conduct a sensitivity analysis on two aspects
units.function: announce the count of aspects before them
units.reusable_pattern: To evaluate the robustness, we conduct a sensitivity analysis on two aspects.
information_order: to evaluate the robustness, on two aspects
prohibited_generalizations: Do not vary a knob without saying it tests robustness.

units.source_excerpt: a longer prediction interval forces the model to prioritize effects with potentially longer durations. On the contrary, short-term events gain less weight
units.function: say what the longer window forces and what loses weight
units.reusable_pattern: Forces the model to prioritize. On the contrary, the short events gain less.
information_order: forces the model to prioritize, on the contrary
prohibited_generalizations: Do not report the change without the direction.

units.source_excerpt: the model trained on 50% appears notable changes, likely due to the altered distribution of matches. On the other hand, the model trained with 70% of the data remained stable, indicating a threshold of data sufficiency
units.function: contrast the two fractions and name the threshold
units.reusable_pattern: Appears notable changes, likely due to. On the other hand, remained stable, indicating a threshold.
information_order: likely due to, on the other hand, remained stable, indicating a threshold
prohibited_generalizations: Do not call both fractions stable.

units.source_excerpt: In this paper, we establish our momentum predictor through a two-step process. Initially, we develop a naive binomial model. Subsequently, the residual of its prediction is utilized as the label
units.function: restate the paper as two steps in the same order as the summary
units.reusable_pattern: Through a two-step process. Initially. Subsequently, the residual is utilized as the label.
information_order: two-step process, initially, subsequently, utilized as the label
prohibited_generalizations: Do not reorder the two steps.

units.source_excerpt: This model framework, demonstrated to be highly generalizable and robust, allows us to uncover the latent systems underlying observable sports games
units.function: close on what the framework makes visible
units.reusable_pattern: Demonstrated to be, allows us to uncover the latent systems underlying.
information_order: allows us to uncover the latent systems underlying
prohibited_generalizations: Do not close on a single match.

units.source_excerpt: Dear Coaches, We are thrilled to share with you our suggestions derived from our Duel-Temporal Bayesian network model
units.function: greet the reader and name the model the advice comes from
units.reusable_pattern: Dear. We are thrilled to share suggestions derived from. Keep Duel.
information_order: dear, we are thrilled to share, derived from
prohibited_generalizations: Do not open the memo with a formula.

units.source_excerpt: the concept of momentum is often cited as a game-changer, potentially turning the tide in pivotal match moments
units.function: use the audience's own name for the phenomenon
units.reusable_pattern: Often cited as, potentially.
information_order: often cited as, potentially turning the tide
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat the saying as a result.

units.source_excerpt: Our research has dissected this phenomenon, aiming to transform the abstract phenomenon into tangible strategies that can be methodically applied
units.function: say what the research turned the abstraction into
units.reusable_pattern: Dissected, aiming to transform the abstract into tangible strategies.
information_order: dissected, transform the abstract into tangible
prohibited_generalizations: Do not stay in the abstract.

units.source_excerpt: while each point's outcome may appears statistically independent to some extent, the Bayesian network we developed tells a richer story
units.function: concede the statistical finding, then say what the model adds, and keep the agreement
units.reusable_pattern: May appears independent to some extent, but tells a richer story. Keep may appears.
information_order: may appears, to some extent, tells a richer story
prohibited_generalizations: Do not repair may appears.

units.source_excerpt: It reveals the hidden threads of self-efficacy, strategy, and physiological responses that weave together to form the fabric of momentum
units.function: name the threads and the fabric they make
units.reusable_pattern: Reveals the hidden threads that weave together to form the fabric of.
information_order: hidden threads, weave together, the fabric of
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a thread the model dropped.

units.source_excerpt: To enable players to harness the positive aspects of momentum while mitigating its pressures, we recommend following strategic pivots
units.function: state both aims of the advice before the list
units.reusable_pattern: To enable while mitigating, we recommend following.
information_order: to enable, while mitigating, we recommend
prohibited_generalizations: Do not list pivots with no aim.

units.source_excerpt: Consistency is Key: Encourage players to minimize unforced errors; our findings link consistent play to maintaining momentum
units.function: give the pivot a short name, then the finding that supports it
units.reusable_pattern: A short name, then our findings link.
information_order: our findings link
prohibited_generalizations: Do not give a pivot with no finding.

units.source_excerpt: We trust this memo provides a clear and actionable strategy for leveraging the concept of momentum to your advantage
units.function: hand the memo to the reader as something to use
units.reusable_pattern: We trust this memo provides a clear and actionable strategy.
information_order: we trust this memo provides
prohibited_generalizations: Do not end on a caveat.

units.source_excerpt: Looking forward to seeing these strategies manifest in your players' enhanced performance. Yours Sincerely, Team #2401298
units.function: close on the reader's future and sign with the team
units.reusable_pattern: Looking forward to seeing. Yours Sincerely.
information_order: looking forward to seeing, yours sincerely
prohibited_generalizations: Do not sign with the algorithm.

units.source_excerpt: Taylor and Demick 1994, a multidimensional model of momentum in sports
units.function: keep the source of the latent variables
units.reusable_pattern: The latent variables come from a named paper.
information_order: named source for the latent variables
prohibited_generalizations: Do not cite a source the text never uses.

units.source_excerpt: Klaassen and Magnus 2001, are points in tennis independent and identically distributed
units.function: keep the source of the independence question
units.reusable_pattern: The i.i.d. question has a named source.
information_order: named source for the i.i.d. question
prohibited_generalizations: Do not invent the journal.

units.source_excerpt: Morber 2008, one-dimensional nanowires, Georgia Institute of Technology
units.function: keep the citation that does not belong to the argument
units.reusable_pattern: Record an off-topic reference as printed. Do not drop it.
information_order: off-topic reference kept
prohibited_generalizations: Do not delete a reference for being off topic.

units.source_excerpt: Ben Gal 2007, Bayesian Networks, encyclopedia of statistics in quality and reliability
units.function: keep the source named for the inference step
units.reusable_pattern: The inference section points at a named encyclopedia entry.
information_order: named source for the network inference
prohibited_generalizations: Do not replace the citation with a textbook.
